cards.ex: She's very fashion-conscious and always knows the latest trends.
cards.exUz: U juda modaga e'tiborli va har doim eng so'nggi trendlarni biladi.
cards.uzDef: Moda va zamonaviy uslublarga qiziqadigan va e'tibor beradigan odam.

cards.ex: He's always been a sharp dresser; he really knows how to put an outfit together.
cards.exUz: U doim chiroyli kiyinadi; u kiyimni qanday uyg'unlashtirishni yaxshi biladi.
cards.uzDef: Doim o'ziga yarashiqli va zamonaviy kiyinadigan odam.

cards.ex: She dressed to kill for her date last night; she looked stunning.
cards.exUz: U kecha o'z uchrashuvi uchun hayratlantirib kiyindi; u juda ajoyib ko'rindi.
cards.uzDef: Juda jozibali va diqqatni tortadigan tarzda kiyinmoq.

cards.ex: The building looked a bit down at heel, but it had character.
cards.exUz: Bino biroz eski tusda edi, lekin unda o'ziga xoslik bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Eski, eskirgan va yomon ahvolda bo'lgan (kiyim yoki tashqi ko'rinish).

cards.ex: The ballroom was decked out in flowers and lights for the wedding.
cards.exUz: To'yxona to'y uchun gullar va chiroqlar bilan bezatilgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Odatda hashamatli yoki tantanali tarzda kiyingan yoki bezatilgan.

cards.ex: She doesn't just follow fashion; she creates her own style.
cards.exUz: U shunchaki modaga ergashmaydi; u o'z uslubini yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Moda trendlariga rioya qilish va ularga mos kiyim kiyish.

cards.ex: Those wide-leg jeans are starting to go out of style.
cards.exUz: O'sha keng oyoqli jinslar modadan qola boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Endi moda bo'lmay qolgan, zamonaviy bo'lmagan.

cards.ex: She's a real slave to fashion, always buying the latest designer clothes.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy moda quli, doimo eng so'nggi dizayner kiyimlarini sotib oladi.
cards.uzDef: Modaga haddan tashqari berilib ketgan va unga ergashishga majbur bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: She has a great sense of style; she always looks effortlessly chic.
cards.exUz: U ajoyib uslub hissiga ega; u doimo bemalol zamonaviy ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga xos va yoqimli tarzda kiyinish qobiliyatiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: I prefer high street fashion because it's affordable and trendy.
cards.exUz: Men omma bozori modasini afzal ko'raman, chunki u arzon va zamonaviy.
cards.uzDef: Asosan ko'pchilikka mo'ljallangan arzon va zamonaviy kiyimlar.

cards.ex: She only wears designer labels; she's very particular about her clothes.
cards.exUz: U faqat dizayner brendlarini kiyadi; u o'z kiyimlariga juda talabchan.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur dizayner yoki moda uyi tomonidan yaratilgan kiyim brendi.

cards.ex: I'd love to go to a runway show during fashion week.
cards.exUz: Men moda haftaligida defile namoyishiga borishni xohlardim.
cards.uzDef: Moda dizaynerlari o'zlarining yangi kollektsiyalarini ko'rsatadigan namoyish.

cards.ex: He received a warning for a dress code violation at work.
cards.exUz: U ish joyida kiyim qoidasini buzgani uchun ogohlantirish oldi.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan kiyim qoidalariga rioya qilmaslik.

cards.ex: Wearing socks with sandals is considered a major fashion faux pas.
cards.exUz: Sandal bilan paypoq kiyish katta moda xatosi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Moda sohasida qabul qilinmagan yoki qo'pol xato.

cards.ex: She's great at mix-and-match; she always creates interesting outfits.
cards.exUz: U aralashtirib moslashda ajoyib; u doimo qiziqarli kiyimlar yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil kiyimlarni uyg'unlashtirib, o'ziga xos ko'rinish yaratish.

cards.ex: She can really rock the vintage look; she looks amazing in those old dresses.
cards.exUz: U haqiqatan ham vintage ko'rinishni uddalay oladi; u o'sha eski ko'ylaklarda ajoyib ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan uslubdagi kiyimni ishonch bilan va yaxshi ko'rinishda kiyish.

cards.ex: Her designs are always on the cutting edge; she's a true visionary.
cards.exUz: Uning dizaynlari doimo eng zamonaviy; u haqiqiy visioner.
cards.uzDef: Moda yoki texnologiyada eng ilg'or va zamonaviy bo'lgan.

cards.ex: I usually buy my suits off the peg; it's cheaper than getting them tailored.
cards.exUz: Men odatda kostyumlarimni tayyor kiyimdan sotib olaman; uni tiktirishdan ko'ra arzonroq.
cards.uzDef: Do'konda tayyor holda sotiladigan kiyim, buyurtma asosida tikilmagan.

cards.ex: He always wears bespoke suits; he's very particular about the fit.
cards.exUz: U doimo buyurtma kostyumlarini kiyadi; u o'lchamga juda talabchan.
cards.uzDef: Mijozning o'lchovlari bo'yicha maxsus tikilgan kostyum.

cards.ex: She's such a clothes horse; her closet is overflowing.
cards.exUz: U shunday kiyim ixlosmandi; uning shkafi to'lib-toshgan.
cards.uzDef: Kiyimlarga juda qiziqadigan va ko'p kiyim sotib oladigan odam.

cards.ex: His dress sense is impeccable; he always looks so stylish.
cards.exUz: Uning kiyinish didi benuqson; u doimo juda zamonaviy ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Kiyimlarni tanlash va uyg'unlashtirish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: She dreams of working for a famous fashion house one day.
cards.exUz: U bir kun kelib mashhur modalar uyida ishlashni orzu qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Moda dizayni va ishlab chiqarish bilan shug'ullanadigan kompaniya.

cards.ex: They were struggling financially, but they tried to keep up appearances.
cards.exUz: Ular moddiy jihatdan qiynalishardi, lekin ular ko'rinishni saqlashga harakat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining boy yoki baxtli ekanligini ko'rsatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I just threw on a jacket before I left the house.
cards.exUz: Men uydan chiqishdan oldin shunchaki jaket kiyib oldim.
cards.uzDef: Tezda va e'tibor bermay kiyim kiyib olmoq.

cards.ex: Her dress was so stunning that she turned heads wherever she went.
cards.exUz: Uning ko'ylagi shunchalik ajoyib ediki, u qayerga bormasin, odamlarning e'tiborini tortardi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli yoki noodatiy bo'lganligi sababli odamlarning e'tiborini tortmoq.

cards.ex: Some people say clothes maketh the man, but I think it's more about personality.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar kiyim insonni yaratadi deyishadi, lekin menimcha, bu ko'proq shaxsiyat haqida.
cards.uzDef: Insonning kiyimi uning qanday ekanligiga ta'sir qiladi.

cards.ex: We have a dress rehearsal tomorrow night before the show opens.
cards.exUz: Ertaga kechqurun shou ochilishidan oldin bosh repetitsiyamiz bor.
cards.uzDef: Spektakl yoki tadbirning to'liq repetitsiyasi, kiyimlar bilan.

cards.ex: Her makeup is always on fleek; she's a pro.
cards.exUz: Uning bo'yanishi har doim ajoyib; u professional.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi, mukammal (odatda tashqi ko'rinish haqida).

cards.ex: I love shopping for vintage clothing at flea markets.
cards.exUz: Men bit bozorlarida vintage kiyimlarni xarid qilishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Eski, lekin hali ham yaxshi holatda bo'lgan kiyimlar.

cards.ex: She's always been fashion forward, experimenting with new styles.
cards.exUz: U doimo modada ilg'or bo'lgan, yangi uslublar bilan tajriba o'tkazgan.
cards.uzDef: Eng so'nggi moda trendlariga ergashishni xohlovchi.
